description: Responsive layouts, navigation, and guest pages. Fix the mobile hamburger menu wiring in layouts/app.blade.php (button exists but never opens a menu), tighten guest layout auth-card grids at 320px, and add mobile padding fixes to layouts/admin.blade.php. The nav partial and footer partial are already responsive — only the announcement bar overflow fix and app.blade.php hamburger need work.
steps: READ context.json at .agents/tasks/task-responsive-platform/context.json and FEAT-001.json before starting. Do not re-derive what is already stated there.

READ resources/views/layouts/app.blade.php in full. The mobile hamburger button (md:hidden div) renders an SVG icon but has no Alpine x-data, no x-show on a mobile menu, and no @click handler. Fix: (1) Add x-data="{ mobileOpen: false }" to the outer <nav> element. (2) Add @click="mobileOpen = !mobileOpen" to the hamburger <button>. (3) Below the main nav div, add a mobile menu div: <div x-show="mobileOpen" x-cloak x-transition class="md:hidden bg-white border-t border-gray-200 px-4 py-3 space-y-1"> containing the same @auth links (Dashboard, Sessions, Messages) plus Login/Register for @else, mirroring the desktop nav. Use Tailwind classes (this file already uses Tailwind CDN). Preserve all existing element IDs and Alpine notification logic.

READ resources/views/layouts/admin.blade.php. The admin layout already has a fully working mobile sidebar. Only add .admin-content { padding: 16px; } and .topbar { padding: 0 16px; } inside a new @media(max-width:639px){} block appended to the existing <style> tag.

READ resources/views/layouts/guest.blade.php. Add a @media(max-width:400px){} block inside the existing <style> tag: .social-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } and .role-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } and .guest-header { padding: 16px; }.

READ resources/views/partials/nav.blade.php. The announcement bar text can overlap the dismiss button at 320px. Add a @media(max-width:640px){} block in the trailing <style>: the announcement bar div needs padding-right:48px on narrow screens. Target the inline style by adding a class mw-ann-bar to the announcement bar div, then .mw-ann-bar { padding-right: 48px; } inside the media query.
Commit all four file changes with message: 'feat(responsive): fix mobile hamburger, admin padding, guest grids, ann bar overflow'
acceptance_criteria: On a 375px viewport, tapping the hamburger in layouts/app.blade.php opens a dropdown showing Dashboard/Sessions/Messages (or Login/Register for guests), and tapping again closes it
On a 320px viewport, the guest login/register page has no horizontal scroll and the role/social grids do not overflow
On a 375px viewport, the admin panel content area has comfortable padding and the sidebar slides in/out correctly
On a 320px viewport, the announcement bar text does not overlap the dismiss × button
verification: Chrome DevTools → 375px → navigate to a page using layouts/app.blade.php (e.g. /sessions) → tap hamburger → confirm mobile menu appears and closes
Chrome DevTools → 320px → navigate to /login or /register → confirm no horizontal scrollbar
Chrome DevTools → 375px → navigate to /admin/dashboard → confirm sidebar toggle works and content is not clipped
findings: Added x-data={mobileOpen:false} to nav in app.blade.php, wired hamburger @click and x-show on mobile menu div with auth/guest links. Added @media(max-width:639px) block to admin.blade.php setting admin-content and topbar padding to 16px. Added @media(max-width:400px) block to guest.blade.php collapsing social-grid to 1 column, role-grid to 2 columns, and guest-header padding to 16px. Added mw-ann-bar class to announcement bar div in nav.blade.php and @media(max-width:640px) rule setting padding-right:48px to prevent text/button overlap.
